# Timothy Cotton

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Personality

Timothy Cotton is a member of a family from [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) that relocated to the area. He is characterized by others as shiftless and expected to become a public burden.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)_

## History

Timothy Cotton stole a crock of butter from Mrs. Lynde's dairy. Following the theft, he lied to his wife, claiming that he had purchased the butter from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) directly.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +24 more_
